persons.name: Jayabhūpatīndramalladeva
persons.evidence: śrīśrījayabhūpatīndra malladevasana kārttikavrata dhunakāyā vighniharaṇa bali biyāyā thva sāphula

notes: Jayabhūpatīndramalla was the King of Bhaktapur (r. 1696–1722 CE). The manuscript was prepared for his performance of the Vighnaharaṇabali after concluding the Kārttikavrata.
